subject: general
question: The ________ was set up in 1963 with responsibilities in the field of seed production, particularly the foundation stock of HYV seeds.
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Seeds Corporation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Seeds Corporation (NSC)** is a **government-owned enterprise** that was established in **1963.**
 
• NSC is responsible for producing and distributing **high-quality certified seeds** of various crops to farmers across India.
 
• The corporation also maintains the foundation seed stock of various crops, including **high-yielding varieties (HYVs).**
 
• NSC has played a crucial role in the** Green Revolution in India **by providing farmers with quality seeds and promoting the adoption of modern agricultural practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are several state-level agricultural corporations that produce and distribute seeds, such as the** Karnataka State Seeds Corporation **and the **Tamil Nadu Agricultural University Seed Centre.**
